hypothesis: 在新开发原问中，仅改变证据条目的输入位置并映回原事实编号后，冻结 R12 的首跳选择保持不变。将候选槽位和检索前事实顺序作为两个独立干预分别检验。
criteria: 逐种子原序对照须复现已封存 R12 预测、金标和池化及首位基线，评分容差 2e-5。在不改变候选成员的干预中，如任一 R12 选中的事实发生变化，即反驳严格的槽位不变性。在倒置全部事实并重建候选后，如出现任一改变，即反驳端到端严格不变性。个体不变性和平均准确率效应分开报告，准确率升降均保留。
primary_units: 600 previously observed fresh-development graphs × seeds 1701,2701,3701. Original wording only. Three types equally weighted. No training, no formal set access. One fixed reversal per intervention per graph, not an average over all permutations.
interventions: reverse order of two retained candidates with original facts fixed
reverse all 12 fact rows and rebuild original direction shortlist
secondary: Coverage, candidate membership and order, per-model prediction flips, ties, accuracy differences in percentage points. Descriptive two-sided 95% paired bootstrap 10000 draws, stratified by type after averaging the three seeds within graph. Interventions and contrasts use the same draws. No new H3 decision or model selection.
